text.title: Great tit
text.menu_sub: Flit between trees and find seeds and insects.
text.menu_wild: Watch for predators while feeding on the ground.
text.intro: Hold Fly to climb. Find seeds and insects, then rest among tree branches.
text.hungry: Look for seeds and insects on the forest floor.
text.no_food: No seeds or insects nearby. Search another patch of forest.
text.chased: A predator! Fly into the trees.
text.nearby: A great tit flits between the trees.
text.about_looks: A small bird with a black head, white cheeks and a yellow belly with a black stripe.
text.about_food: Insects and caterpillars, and seeds especially in autumn and winter.
text.about_home: Lives in woods, parks and gardens. Nests in a tree hole or nest box.
text.about_winter: Many stay in Finland through winter, searching for food with other tits.
text.about_young: The young hatch in a sheltered cavity in spring or early summer.
text.about_fact: Its familiar two-note spring song sounds like ti-tyy.

year.shelter: Roosts and nests in tree holes or boxes; the game approximates shelter with crowns.
year.young: Nests in cavities in spring and early summer.
year.notes: Resident encounter species. Cavity nesting is not yet simulated.
